product.name: Slim-Fit Cargo Pants
product.description: Slim-fit pants in woven cotton with a fitted silhouette. Drawstring, covered elastic, and mock fly at waistband. Diagonal side pockets, back pockets with flap and concealed snap fasteners, and leg pockets with flap and concealed snap fasteners. Tapered legs with seams and darts at knees.
